candidats.description: A compost heap bin at the northwest of the walled garden, called 'The Kitchen Garden', 390 yards (360 m) northwest from Copped Hall , aka Copt Hall or Copthall, a Grade II listed country house , 1.5 miles (2 km) west from the town of Epping , Essex , England. The house and its ancillary buildings are within the civil parish of Epping Upland , with the larger part of the gardens to the west, in Waltham Abbey . candidats.titre: File:Centre Point - New Oxford Street, Holborn.jpg
candidats.description: Modern architecture in Holborn. Seen after we left the British Museum. Initially we were heading down New Oxford Street. I wasn't sure which way Tottenham Court Road Underground Station was, so ended up going via Centre Saint Giles onto High Holborn (then found our way to Holborn Underground Station). Was probably better to go there, as only had to get two tube trains back to Victoria. Centre Point seen down New Oxford Street. It's at 101–103 New Oxford Street. Built between 1961 and 1966. The current construction work is due to Crossrail. The building is Grade II listed. Centre Point and Pond
